notes: Earlier versions of recipes are no longer kept, and the Earlier versions section is gone
Notes still show what they changed, and "rate it again" still appears after the recipe is edited
Settings shows a version number and what's new in it, with earlier versions underneath
The update banner says which version is ready and what it changes
After an update, the app shows what's new once
Imported screenshots and PDFs aren't kept after you save; they show only while you check the recipe
Import picks up who a recipe is credited to, and the recipe shows "From ..."
New Credit field when adding or editing a recipe
Recipe cards in the Library show the average rating and how often you've made it
The update banner stays pinned to the top of the screen, and the app checks for updates more often
Notes look like a comments thread
A note can be turned into a recipe change only once, and then shows that it was used
A loading indicator with a seconds counter while Gemini works
Faster Gemini answers for imports, nutrition, and step questions
The app offers updates with a banner instead of quietly keeping an old copy
Changes from a note cover every part of the note, and anything Gemini couldn't apply is flagged
Saving a change from a note no longer posts a duplicate note
You can delete notes you wrote
Nutrition estimates: calories, protein, carbs, and fat per serving and for how much you ate
Ratings belong to the recipe and carry over each time you make it
The cook log is a diary of the dates you made a recipe
When you both log the same dinner, it counts as one meal
Turn a note into a recipe change: Gemini drafts it, you approve it
Earlier versions of a recipe can be viewed and restored
Cooking mode: one step at a time, large text, screen kept on
Ask Gemini about a step while cooking
Cook log with a rating from each of you, and a Stats page
Import recipes from screenshots, PDFs, links, and pasted text
Add and edit recipes, scale servings, switch units, leave notes, and use it offline
Remove a cook or leave a kitchen
Sign in, create a shared kitchen, and invite each other
